[EN] For the uninitiated, Dakonan Junction is an easy place to get lost. If you go south, there are two caves that lead to the Nightwood. If you go east, you'll end up in Amena Quatla. Sometimes, people end up going to the Nightwood by accident and never return.
[ES] Para los no iniciados, Dakonan Junction es un lugar fácil para perderse. Si vas al sur, hay dos cuevas que llevan a Nightwood. Si vas al este, terminarás en Amena Quatla. A veces, la gente termina yendo a Nightwood por accidente y nunca regresa.
